variants.when: Land Rover models with a sensor in each wheel (for example 2017 Evoque and 2023 Range Rover)
steps: Set all four tires, and a monitored full-size spare if fitted, to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
There is no reset button. The system reads each sensor by itself, so correct pressures are what clear the light.
Check the tire pressure monitoring load setting in the vehicle menus and match it to how loaded the vehicle is (light or normal, or normal or heavy, depending on the model).
If a wheel or tire was removed or swapped, drive for at least 15 minutes so the system can relearn.
Drive above about 16 to 18 mph. A low-pressure warning should clear within about 5 to 10 minutes.
If the light stays on after that, have the tires and system checked by a qualified shop.
variants.note: If the light flashes for about a minute or more and then stays on, the system has a fault or cannot read a sensor. Setting pressures will not clear that.

notes: Land Rover tire pressure systems use a sensor in each wheel and relearn by driving, with no driver reset button. The owner's handbooks we opened say the service reminder countdown is reset when a service is completed but give no steps a driver can follow, so ask the shop that did the oil change to reset it.
